Senior Product Manager (ShelfView)

Scandit ZURICH

Imagine the what. Build the how.
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

Your opportunity

As a Product Manager for ShelfView Capture, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how ShelfView acquires shelf data — a cornerstone of ShelfView's hybrid data capture. You'll work at the intersection of UX, mobile engineering, and computer vision to make capture fast, simple, and reliable, and to ensure the right shelf data is collected at the right quality, coverage, and cost.

ShelfView turns images and video from mobile devices, fixed cameras, and autonomous robots into a digital twin of the store, generating insights that remove tedious tasks for retail workers. Your mission is to make the capture experience best-in-class for accuracy, cost, and speed.

•

What You Will Do

•
    •
  • Partner with customers and field teams to understand capture environments and translate needs into requirements.
    • •
  • Build and drive the ShelfView capture roadmap toward high throughput, coverage, and quality at the right cost.
    • •
  • Define and deliver a better capture experience (e.g., improved video capture, AR guidance, faster and more reliable first-time-right capture).
    • •
  • Own how capture work is tasked and scheduled — which stores and aisles are captured, how often, and by whom.
    • •
  • Own store onboarding and modeling — getting stores ready (mapping, planograms, catalogs) and keeping them current as stores change.
    • •
  • Define capture quality, product metrics, and telemetry, and run experiments to inform iterative development.
    • •
  • Work closely with design, mobile engineering, and CV teams to evaluate new technologies that improve capture success
    • •
  • Drive non-mobile, hybrid capture (fixed camera, robot and emerging technologies).
    • •
  • Coordinate feature launches with product marketing and sales operations; act as the capture point of contact on pilots and early customer rollouts.
    • •
•

Who You Are

•
    •
  • Degree in Engineering or a related field.
    • •
  • 6+ years of product management experience in a "Deep Tech" or mobile SaaS company, or equivalent product leadership experience in a startup.
    • •
  • Experience with mobile apps, AR use-cases, or on-device ML is beneficial.
    • •
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify user needs; comfortable working hands-on with data/telemetry.
    • •
  • Open-minded, sociable, and driven personality.
    • •
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.
    • •
  • Eligible to work in Switzerland.
    • •
  • Ability to visit customers in Europe and North America on occasion.
    • •
  • You will either be living within a commutable distance of our Zurich office.
    • •
•

The good stuff
Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their career at Scandit:

•
    •
  • We are certified as a “Great Place to Work” in 7 countries!
    • •
  • Smart, people-first culture

Rejoignez-nous alors que nous continuons de nous développer, de croître, d'innover et d'aider à faire passer Scandit au niveau suivant.

En tant que gestionnaire de produit pour ShelfView Capture, vous serez propriétaire de la stratégie et de la feuille de route pour la façon dont SheltView acquiert les données sur les étagères — une pierre angulaire de la capture de données hybrides de SheltView.
